reproduction_target: The computational chain supporting the central claim that resistant Drosophila suzukii lines show globally elevated alternative splicing: (a) de novo repeat library + softmasking of the LBDM_Dsuz_2.1.pri assembly, (b) BRAKER3 + PacBio Iso-Seq/TSEBRA genome re-annotation producing 17,159 gene models / 34,354 transcript models, (c) Salmon + SUPPA2 differential splicing analysis, (d) SortMeRNA/fastp/STAR/DESeq2 differential gene expression analysis, (e) ShinyGO functional enrichment, and the associated summary statistics. Wet-lab steps (isofemale line establishment, bioassays, RNA extraction, library prep, sequencing) are out of computational reproduction scope.

steps.label: Establishment of insecticide-resistant/susceptible D. suzukii isofemale lines (8 generations sib-crossing) from field populations
Discriminating-dose glass-vial residue bioassays and sublethal-dose determination (Malathion 102.78 mg/L; 0/5/10/20/40 ppm)
TRI-reagent RNA extraction, Turbo DNase treatment, Bioanalyzer/Qubit/Nanodrop QC
Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA library prep (24 libraries) and HiSeq X Ten PE150 sequencing
PacBio Iso-Seq library prep (48 libraries) and Sequel sequencing on five 8M SMRT cells
De novo repeat library construction with RepeatModeler2 (v2.0.4) on GCF_013340165.1, default settings + '-LTRStruct'
Two-round genome softmasking with RepeatMasker (v4.1.5) using Dfam v3.7 then the de novo repeat library
Retrieval of 56 public D. suzukii RNA-seq SRA datasets (accession list in S. Table 2; last accessed 2023-06-28)
Read quality control with fastqc (v0.12.1) and multiqc (v1.14), pre- and post-trimming
Adapter and low-quality read trimming with Trimmomatic (v0.39) for the annotation-evidence read set (no parameters stated)
Short-read alignment to the softmasked assembly with Hisat2 (v2.2.1) to produce BRAKER3 RNA-seq evidence
Gene model prediction with BRAKER3 (v3.0.3) training ProtHint / GeneMark-ETP+ / AUGUSTUS on Hisat2 evidence + OrthoDB arthropoda_odb11 + D. melanogaster proteome UP000000803_7227
Iso-Seq FLNC generation and clustering/collapse with isoseq (v4.0.0), 'isoseq cluster', 'isoseq collapse' with default settings and '--do-not-collapse-extra-5exons'
Mapping of high-quality Iso-Seq transcripts to the softmasked assembly with pbmm2 (v1.11.99), default settings
Protein-coding region prediction on mapped Iso-Seq transcripts with GeneMarkS-T (v5.1) and unspecified conversion of results to GTF
Merge of BRAKER3 gene models and Iso-Seq transcripts with the long-read version of TSEBRA (git branch 'long_reads', no version or commit, no config given)
GTF-to-GFF conversion, collapse of redundant transcripts and pseudogene annotation with AGAT (v1.2.0)
Ribosomal RNA annotation with rnammer (v1.2) (no parameters stated)
Transfer RNA annotation with tRNAscan-SE (v2.0.12) (no parameters stated)

Functional annotation of the final transcript set with EnTAP (v1.0.1) in '-runP' mode against RefSeq Invertebrate, UniProt SwissProt, UniProtKB/TrEMBL and UP000000803_7227 (all last accessed 2024-02-14)
Transcript quantification of cleaned Illumina reads with Salmon (v1.10.1), default parameters (index construction not described; prose says reads were mapped to the genome assembly GCF_013340165.1)

Differential splicing with SUPPA2 (v2.3): generateEvents '-e {SE,SS,MX,RI,FL}', psiPerEvent, diffsplice classical mode (pooled Susceptible reference for R-vs-S; Sus_1 reference for S-vs-S), FDR < 0.05
Percentage-of-significant-events computation and Fisher's Exact Test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction 'on R' (no R version, no package, no script for this analysis)
GO enrichment with ShinyGO 0.76.3, FDR < 0.05 (species/background gene set and ontology database version not stated)
rRNA read removal with SortMeRNA (v2.1) (no rRNA reference database or parameters stated)
Adapter/quality trimming with fastp (v0.24.0); stated settings are Trimmomatic-style (ILLUMINACLIP 2:30:10, LEADING:10, TRAILING:10, MINLEN:36) and do not correspond to fastp flags
Alignment to the in-house re-annotation with STAR (v2.7.11b), '--quantMode GeneCounts' (index build parameters not stated)
Differential expression on STAR GeneCounts with DESeq2 in R (no DESeq2 version, no R version for this analysis, no design formula or script), BH-adjusted p < 0.05
Biological-replicate correlation via Pearson's correlation coefficient using the 'stats' package in R (v4.2.1)
Key-gene expression comparison by two-way ANOVA with Benjamini-Krieger-Yekutieli two-stage procedure in GraphPad Prism v10.3.0 (GUI, no script)

Bioassay mortality comparison by one-way ANOVA with Tukey's multiple comparison in GraphPad Prism v10.3.0; underlying per-replicate mortality counts are not deposited (Dryad holds only gene-level supplementary tables 4-31)

headline.static_readiness: 0/26 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 17/26 (65%) of computational steps reach RI, the stage-1 ceiling; the remaining 9 are capped below RI by absent parameters (6 steps), absent tool versions (3 steps: TSEBRA long_reads branch, DESeq2, the R used for Fisher/BH) and one step (C26, bioassay ANOVA) whose input mortality data is not deposited. No step can exceed RI at stage 1 because version is capped at 1 without environment closure.
headline.coverage: 26/31 named steps are computational (84%); 5 wet-lab steps (line establishment, bioassays, RNA extraction, Illumina and PacBio library prep/sequencing) are out of computational reproduction scope. Methods text fully retrieved from JATS XML; Data availability section present, no Code availability section exists.

gaps_detail.data_absent: C26: per-replicate bioassay mortality counts underlying the one-way ANOVA/Tukey are not deposited; Dryad holds only supplementary tables 4-31 (differentially spliced genes, DEGs, enrichment results).
gaps_detail.code_absent: The paper contains no Code availability statement and no author-controlled repository. The only two GitHub URLs are third-party tool documentation (Gaius-Augustus/BRAKER long_read_protocol.md, Gaius-Augustus/TSEBRA tree/long_reads). All 26 computational steps therefore have no public code artifact; each is scored code=1 (reconstructable from prose + public tools), never code=2.
gaps_detail.version_absent: C11 TSEBRA (branch pointer only, no version/commit), C18 R used for Fisher's Exact + BH ('on R'), C23 DESeq2 (no package version; R version only stated in a different subsection as v4.2.1).
gaps_detail.version_floating: C11 TSEBRA is referenced as a mutable git branch ('tree/long_reads'), not a tag or commit SHA. Reference databases (Dfam v3.7 excepted) are pinned by access date rather than release: OrthoDB arthropoda_odb11 and UP000000803_7227 last accessed 2023-06-28; RefSeq Invertebrate, SwissProt and TrEMBL last accessed 2024-02-14.
gaps_detail.params_absent: C5 Trimmomatic (no trimming parameters), C10 GeneMarkS-T (no parameters; 'converted to GTF format' by unspecified means), C11 TSEBRA (no config file), C13 rnammer, C14 tRNAscan-SE, C20 SortMeRNA (no rRNA reference database).
gaps_detail.env_absent: No conda environment, no environment.yml, no lockfile, no Docker/Singularity image, no workflow manager (Snakemake/Nextflow), no sessionInfo/renv. Grep of the full text for docker|singularity|conda|snakemake|nextflow|lockfile|environment.yml|renv|sessionInfo returned zero hits.
gaps_detail.seed_absent: No random seeds stated for stochastic steps: RepeatModeler2 (C1), BRAKER3/AUGUSTUS training (C7), isoseq cluster (C8).
gaps_detail.hardware_resource_absent: No compute environment, OS, thread counts, memory or runtime reported for any step.
gaps_detail.intermediate_artifact_absent: The central derived artifact of the study - the D. suzukii re-annotation (17,159 gene models / 34,354 transcript models, GTF/GFF plus EnTAP functional annotations) - is not deposited to any repository. Every downstream step (C12, C15, C17, C22, C23) consumes it, so those steps score data=1 rather than 2.
gaps_detail.docs_absent: No Code availability section, no README, no workflow description, no parameter-file deposition.
gaps_detail.prose_inconsistencies_noted: (a) C21 attributes Trimmomatic-style parameters (ILLUMINACLIP 2:30:10, LEADING:10, TRAILING:10, MINLEN:36) to fastp v0.24.0, which does not accept those flags. (b) C16 states Salmon mapped reads to the 'genome assembly (RefSeq: GCF_013340165.1)' while the downstream SUPPA2 analysis operates on the updated in-house annotation; the index actually used is ambiguous. Both recorded as findings, not corrections.

code_repo.verbatim: No code availability statement appears in the article. The only repository URLs in the Methods are third-party tool documentation: 'https://github.com/Gaius-Augustus/BRAKER/blob/master/docs/long_reads/long_read_protocol.md' and 'the long-read version of TSEBRA ( https://github.com/Gaius-Augustus/TSEBRA/tree/long_reads )'. Also cited: 'AGAT (v. 1.2.0) ( https://www.doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3552717 )' and 'fastqc (v 0.12.1, http://www.bioinformatics.babraham.ac.uk/projects/fastqc )' - both are tool citations, not study code.

data_accessions.verbatim: Raw Illumina and PacBio reads have been deposited to the NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) and can be found under BioProject accession numbers PRJNA983428 and PRJNA1143070.
